text: [[img:icon_great_bastion]][[/img]]The Celestial Empire of Cathay spans a vast realm; to earn the recognition of the many regional forces that preserve their old traditions, one must first secure control over the local seat of power.\\n\\n [[col:green]] [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/flag_cth_north.png]][[/img]]Capture 'Nangau' and construct the 'Northern Guard Camp' building chain, and Northern Guard troops bearing the [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/icon_cth_north.png]][[/img]]Mark of Dark Iron will answer your call and march to the Great Bastion\\n\\n[[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/flag_cth_west.png]][[/img]]Capture 'Shangyang' and construct the 'Western Guard Prefecture' building chain, and Western Guard troops bearing the [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/icon_cth_west.png]][[/img]]Mark of Gilding will answer your call and defend the trade roads\\n\\n [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/flag_cth_east.png]][[/img]]Capture 'Lisi' and construct the 'Eastern Guard Post' building chain, and Eastern Guard troops bearing the [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/icon_cth_east.png]][[/img]]Mark of Azure Sky will answer your call and sail the azure seas\\n\\n [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/flag_cth_south.png]][[/img]]Capture 'Fuhong' and construct the 'Southern Guard Bureau' building chain, and Southern Guard troops bearing the [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/icon_cth_south.png]][[/img]]Mark of Cinnabar will answer your call and venture deep into the jungle[[/col]]\\n\\n[[img:icon_great_bastion]][[/img]]Your choice now will determine whether the legendary lords of [[col:green]]the Northern Provinces[[/col]], [[col:green]]the Western Provinces[[/col]], [[col:green]]the Jade Court[[/col]], and [[col:green]]the White Tiger's Claw[[/col]] begin with native special units as part of their starting army
'The ancestral laws must not be changed'
